## Targeting & Offer Optimization

A customer targeting and offer strategy project designed to improve decision quality around who to reach, what to offer, and how to align incentives with business goals.

### Business Problem
How can a business improve campaign efficiency by identifying the right customer segments and matching them with stronger promotional offers?

### Methods
Segmentation analysis, offer performance evaluation, business rule interpretation, and decision-focused recommendation design.

### Tools
SQL, Python, Excel, and analytics workflows built to support targeting logic and performance review.

### Value Delivered
Framed a clearer approach to customer prioritization and offer strategy, with recommendations that support more effective allocation of marketing effort.

## Retail Promotion Uplift & Demand Modeling

A retail analytics project focused on measuring promotional impact and understanding how pricing and demand signals can support stronger planning decisions.

### Business Problem
How can retail and consumer brands evaluate whether promotions are truly driving incremental demand and where pricing or promotional changes may improve outcomes?

### Methods
Promotion uplift analysis, demand modeling, retail record analysis, exploratory data review, and interpretation for commercial decision-making.

### Tools
SQL, Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Excel, and retail data workflows spanning 10K+ records.

### Value Delivered
Developed an evidence-based view of promotion performance that helps stakeholders compare demand response, identify patterns, and make more informed pricing and promotion decisions.
